content.text:
Submitted. Summary of the repair:

- **Level switched to fallback (complete, no hybrid).** The preferred bargain could not clear the deterministic check "preferred indemnity adds no indemnitees beyond Customer and affiliates" — that failure persisted even for a bare-bones insert, because Section 6.3(a)'s existing indemnitee set (Owner Trustee, Indenture Trustee and their officers, directors, employees and agents) cannot be brought within Customer-and-affiliates scope by an addition.
- **Fallback insert** as a new Section 6.3(a)(iii) after p0292: Servicer/Marketing Agent IP infringement indemnity, with only the modification, combination and specification exclusions, procure/modify/replace/refund remedies, and a 3x annual fees super-cap.
- **Removed** the flagged "and hold harmless" language and all preferred-only limbs (breach of Law, data breach, gross negligence/willful misconduct, defence duty, cooperation sentence), which are extras at this level.
- Existing Proceedings procedure, survival and repayment mechanics remain byte-for-byte untouched; the cooperation-duty gap is noted in the rationale rather than redlined.
